text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 14.0 to 14.6 s the wide creek view holds with the car stationary and faint rain on the water. At 14.8 s the picture cuts to a closer view: the white car sits broadside in brown water up to mid-door, windows showing an empty cabin, with small ripple lines at its nose and tail. Caption box stays under the car.
